<div class="card-body">
'''Rebel Squad Leader''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">反乱軍分隊指揮官</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">兵員／トルーパーと「反乱軍衛兵」からなるきっかり3人の“分隊”とともに移動する場合、1フォースで4人全員が移動できる。同じ位置カード上の兵員／トルーパーおよび「反乱軍衛兵」はそれぞれ没収値＋1。「反乱軍衛兵」は分隊指揮官と一緒であれば移動可能となる（フォースは通常通り消費する）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Rebel-Squad-Leader-PSA-164793245.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ペロー・スクランバス中尉は反乱軍の古参士官の類型と言える。ほぼ20年に渡ってオーガナ家に仕え、オルデラン総督家の護衛官としての職務を忠実に果たしてきた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Rebel Squad Leader.

'''Card text:'''
When moving with a squad of exactly 3 troopers and Rebel Guards, all 4 may move for 1 Force. Troopers and Rebel Guards on the same location card are each forfeit +1. Rebel Guards can move if they are with the squad leader, spending Force as usual.

'''Lore:'''
Lieutenant Pello Scrambas is a typical veteran Rebel officer. For nearly 20 years he served the Organa family and faithfully performed his duty as a guard of the Alderaan governor's house.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese uses きっかり, 兵員／トルーパー, 位置カード, and 「反乱軍衛兵」.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Rebel Squad Leader]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
